# p2pchat v0.4.0

This release adds isolated local users to the end-to-end encrypted terminal
chat client.

## Install

```sh
gh release download v0.4.0 \
  --repo AshrithSathu/p2pchat \
  --pattern 'p2p-chat-0.4.0.tgz'
corepack pnpm add --global \
  --allow-build=better-sqlite3 \
  --allow-build=@signalapp/libsignal-client \
  ./p2p-chat-0.4.0.tgz
p2pchat --profile alice
```

Requires Node.js 22 or newer and Corepack.

## Local profiles

```sh
p2pchat --profile alice
p2pchat --profile bob
```

Opening a new profile creates it and prompts for its own password. Each profile
has a separate database, identity, ratchet state, peer list, and history. The
old global passphrase environment override has been removed. Existing databases
remain available under the `default` profile.

## Security

Profiles improve local separation but do not provide operating-system sandboxing
between users who can read the same account's files. PQXDH, Double Ratchet,
encrypted local records, and identity-bound safety numbers remain unchanged.

This release has not received an independent security audit. Read `SECURITY.md`
and compare safety numbers before sharing sensitive information.
